title: What's inside the new Brawl Stars boxes? Real drop chances
description:
What the Coffin Box, Pumpkin Box and Vince Box really drop 📦

Coffin Box: Legendary Brawler 0.05% per drop (1 in 2,000), Mythic Brawler 0.15%, Buffie 0.20%.
Pumpkin Box: Legendary Brawler 0.10%, Gadget 2.5%, Star Power 1.0%.
Vince Box: Vince himself 0.33% per drop.

Daily Wins this season: normal days give a Chaos Drop or a Pumpkin Box plus Starr Drops, lucky days two Pumpkin Boxes, luckiest days a Coffin Box and Chaos Drops.

Every drop and box, every chance: brawlzone.net/starr-drops
Chances from the Brawl Stars Wiki (community data, not official).
